collections.name: Tutima Glashütte/Sa.
collections.description: Modest gold watches made with superior manufacturing skill, have a centuries-old tradition in Germany. With the Patria, we keep Glashütte’s deep-rooted horological tradition alive.

collections.name: Tutima Glashütte/Sa.
collections.description: The NATO chronograph by Tutima, developed in 1984 and the official service watch of the German army’s pilots to this day, has outstandingly proven itself in global use for decades.

collections.name: Tutima Glashütte/Sa.
collections.description: The Grand Flieger is the current reedition of the historical Tutima pilot’s chronograph from the 1940s. A timepiece that has long since become a legend thanks to its reliability and functionality.

collections.name: Tutima Glashütte/Sa.
collections.description: The Saxon One is the highlight of the Tutima collection “made in Glashütte.” Our dynamic new beginning at our founding location is manifest within it.

collections.name: Tutima Glashütte/Sa.
